program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),   # bottom (mirror) devices gm/Id
    "L_b":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),      # bottom L: sets ro and matching
    "gmid_c": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),   # cascode gm/Id (low Vdsat for compliance)
    "L_c":    (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),      # cascode L: sets intrinsic gain
    "vds_b":  (0.13, 0.09, 0.2),    # target Vds of bottom devices (sets compliance)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout = spec.get("iout_target", 5e-6)
    vnom = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    ratio = iout / iref                     # 0.25
    m_ref = int(round(1.0 / ratio))         # 4 unit fingers on the reference side
    vdsb = p["vds_b"]

    mb_out = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iout, vds=vdsb)
    mb_ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iref, vds=vdsb)
    mc_out = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iout, vds=max(vnom - vdsb, 0.1), vsb=vdsb)
    mc_ref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iref, vds=max(mb_ref.vgs - vdsb, 0.1), vsb=vdsb)

    # Diode node x = Vgs_b; cascode gate = Vgs_b + Iref*R; bottom Vds = gate - Vgs_c
    R = max((vdsb + mc_ref.vgs - mb_ref.vgs) / iref, 100.0)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # Reference branch: iin -> R -> x; cascode gate at top of R (node iin)
    n.R("RB", "iin", "x", R)
    n.dev("MC1", "x",  "iin", "s1", "vss", mc_ref, m=m_ref)
    n.dev("MB1", "s1", "x",   "vss", "vss", mb_ref, m=m_ref)
    # Output branch
    n.dev("MC2", "iout", "iin", "s2", "vss", mc_out, m=1)
    n.dev("MB2", "s2",   "x",   "vss", "vss", mb_out, m=1)

    ro_b = 1.0 / mb_out.gds
    ro_c = 1.0 / mc_out.gds
    rout = ro_b + ro_c + (mc_out.gm + mc_out.gmbs) * ro_c * ro_b
    v_comp = vdsb + 0.8 * mc_out.vdsat
    # residual error: small Vds mismatch (~10 mV) of bottom devices via gds
    err = 100.0 * mb_out.gds * 0.01 / iout
    power = vnom * iout
    return n, {"rout": rout, "v_compliance": v_comp,
               "iout_err_pct": err, "power": power}
